quick_skim.title: DOFFO_TR: a Decentralized Objective Function-Free Optimization method with Trust-Region
quick_skim.abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel objective function-free trust-region method designed to solve optimization problems over decentralized networks. Unlike traditional approaches that often rely on stepsize tuning, our framework employs a function-free trust-region procedure that enables adaptive selection of the step length. Our approach accommodates first- and second-order models and eliminates the need to share local function values and gradients among agents, thereby enhancing privacy and computational efficiency. On the theoretical side, we establish provable iteration complexity guarantees that, for some variants, match those established for classical centralized trust-region methods. Numerical evaluations demonstrate that our approach achieves a favorable trade-off between performance and efficiency, requiring only moderate communication overhead compared to state-of-the-art methods in the literature.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: DOFFO_TR is a decentralized trust-region optimization method with adaptive steps that avoids sharing local functions and gradients among agents, giving provable complexity guarantees and enhancing privacy for distributed coordination.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对分布式多智能体优化中共享函数与梯度带来的隐私负担和步长调整困难，论文提出去中心化且不共享目标函数的信任域方法DOFFO_TR。该方法采用无目标函数信任域过程自适应选择步长，支持一阶与二阶代理模型，仅需相邻智能体间少量信息交换。理论分析显示部分变体的迭代复杂度可与经典集中式信任域方法相当。由于无需目标函数形式与全局梯度，该方法适合通信受限、隐私敏感的多机器人协调与分布式决策场景。
